notes: Voice removed: Muse's native live calls replace the JC voice channel, so /speak, /speak-audio, the floating orb, the mute pill and the phone-TTS picker are gone, the SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW permission is dropped, and /ping no longer reports voice fields. Everything else is unchanged: /alert (chime + vibration + optional clip) still fires instantly, and car lock, notifications + Secure Folder rules, device control, WireGuard and health bridges work exactly as before.
